tweaks.name: Disable network adapter power saving (EEE / Green Ethernet / NIC sleep)
tweaks.why: Energy-Efficient Ethernet, Green Ethernet and NIC power-down features can add latency spikes or brief link drops. Desktops don't need them. Uses standard driver keywords, so it works on any Windows language; settings an adapter doesn't have are skipped.
tweaks.breaks: Slightly higher idle power; Wake-on-LAN may stop working.

tweaks.name: Disable Nagle / delayed ACK (TcpAckFrequency, TCPNoDelay)
tweaks.why: Only affects games that use TCP (some MMOs and older titles). CS2, Valorant, Fortnite, Apex and most shooters use UDP, so this does nothing for them.

tweaks.name: Disable network throttling (NetworkThrottlingIndex)
tweaks.why: Removes the packet-processing limit MMCSS applies while media plays. Testing (djdallmann) found it can INCREASE network DPC latency, so it is not recommended for games; listed because many guides include it.
